<br>
缘来：<br>
一个碟，整轨里只有几首喜欢的歌曲，都站在播放列表里，又不想清除出列表。<br>
更中意cue列表，但cue在引用另外一个cue里的歌曲时，有bug，就是下图中的“屏蔽”项。<br>
<br>
功能：<br>
1、从资源管理器，拖（单首）歌曲到软件上（左边窗口）。<br>
2、从资源管理器，拖CUE到软件上（右边窗口）。拖入新的cue时，清屏上一个cue内容。<br>
3、左边窗口可上下调整歌曲顺序。<br>

本代码由[Tkinter布局助手]生成
官网:[url=https://www.pytk.net]https://www.pytk.net[/url]
"""
import os
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from xml.dom import minidom
from tkinter import *
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox
from tkinter.ttk import *
from tkinterdnd2 import Tk, DND_FILES, DND_TEXT
import cueparser
import re

class XSPFGenerator:
    """生成XSPF播放列表"""
    @staticmethod
    def format_time(value):
        """四舍五入保留2位小数"""
        return round(float(value), 2)
    
    @staticmethod
    def cue_time_to_seconds(time_str):
        """将CUE时间格式(MM:SS:FF)转换为秒"""
        try:
            if ':' in time_str:
                parts = time_str.split(':')
                if len(parts) == 3:
                    # 格式: 分:秒:帧 (1帧 = 1/75秒)
                    minutes = int(parts[0])
                    seconds = int(parts[1])
                    frames = int(parts[2])
                    total_seconds = minutes * 60 + seconds + frames / 75.0
                    return total_seconds
            return float(time_str)
        except:
            return 0.0
    
    @staticmethod
    def generate_xspf(songs, output_path):
        """生成XSPF播放列表文件"""
        # 创建根元素
        playlist = ET.Element("playlist", version="1", xmlns="http://xspf.org/ns/0/")
        playlist.set("xmlns:aimp", "http://www.aimp.ru/playlist/ns/0/")
        
        # 创建trackList元素
        track_list = ET.SubElement(playlist, "trackList")
        
        # 添加歌曲
        for song in songs:
            track = ET.SubElement(track_list, "track")
            
            # 添加location元素（必须项）
            if 'path' in song and song['path']:
                location = ET.SubElement(track, "location")
                # 转换为file://格式
                file_path = song['path'].replace('\\', '/')
                location.text = f"file:///{file_path}"
            
            # 添加title元素（必须项）
            if 'title' in song:
                title = ET.SubElement(track, "title")
                title.text = song['title']
            
            # 添加creator元素（可选）
            if 'performer' in song and song['performer']:
                creator = ET.SubElement(track, "creator")
                creator.text = song['performer']
            elif 'artist' in song and song['artist']:
                creator = ET.SubElement(track, "creator")
                creator.text = song['artist']
            
            # 添加album元素（可选）
            if 'album' in song and song['album']:
                album = ET.SubElement(track, "album")
                album.text = song['album']
            
            # 添加trackNum元素（可选）
            if 'track_num' in song and song['track_num']:
                track_num = ET.SubElement(track, "trackNum")
                track_num.text = song['track_num']
            
            # 对于CUE歌曲，必须添加AIMP扩展信息
            if 'cue_info' in song:
                cue_info = song['cue_info']
                # 创建扩展元素（必须项）
                ext_track = ET.SubElement(track, "extension", application="http://www.aimp.ru/playlist/track/0")
                
                # 添加fileURI（可选）
                if 'fileURI' in cue_info and cue_info['fileURI']:
                    file_uri = ET.SubElement(ext_track, "aimp:fileURI")
                    file_uri.text = cue_info['fileURI']
                
                # 添加clipStart（必须项，四舍五入保留2位小数）
                if 'clipStart' in cue_info:
                    clip_start = ET.SubElement(ext_track, "aimp:clipStart")
                    clip_start.text = str(XSPFGenerator.format_time(cue_info['clipStart']))
                
                # 添加clipFinish（必须项，四舍五入保留2位小数）
                if 'clipFinish' in cue_info:
                    clip_finish = ET.SubElement(ext_track, "aimp:clipFinish")
                    clip_finish.text = str(XSPFGenerator.format_time(cue_info['clipFinish']))
            
            # 添加group扩展（可选，仅对从资源管理器拖入的文件）
            elif 'group_title' in song and song['group_title']:
                ext_group = ET.SubElement(track, "extension", application="http://www.aimp.ru/playlist/group/0")
                group_title = ET.SubElement(ext_group, "aimp:title")
                group_title.text = song['group_title']
                group_state = ET.SubElement(ext_group, "aimp:state")
                group_state.text = "2"
        
        # 生成XML字符串
        rough_string = ET.tostring(playlist, encoding='utf-8')
        reparsed = minidom.parseString(rough_string)
        # 格式化XML，添加缩进和换行
        xml_str = reparsed.toprettyxml(indent="\t", encoding='utf-8').decode('utf-8')
        
        # 写入文件
        try:
            with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                # 移除&lt;?xml&gt;声明后的空行
                lines = xml_str.split('\n')
                f.write(lines[0] + '\n')
                f.write(lines[1] + '\n')
                for line in lines[2:]:
                    if line.strip():
                        f.write(line + '\n')
            messagebox.showinfo("成功", f"XSPF列表已保存到: {output_path}")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("错误", f"保存XSPF文件失败: {e}")

class DragDropListbox(Listbox):
    """支持拖放的Listbox"""
    def __init__(self, master, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(master, **kwargs)
        self.bind('&lt;Button-1&gt;', self.on_button_press)
        self.bind('&lt;B1-Motion&gt;', self.on_button_motion)
        self.bind('&lt;ButtonRelease-1&gt;', self.on_button_release)
        self.dragged_item = None
        self.drag_start_y = 0
    
    def on_button_press(self, event):
        """鼠标按下事件"""
        index = self.nearest(event.y)
        self.dragged_item = index
        self.drag_start_y = event.y
    
    def on_button_motion(self, event):
        """鼠标拖动事件"""
        if self.dragged_item is None:
            return
        
        current_index = self.nearest(event.y)
        if current_index != self.dragged_item:
            # 交换位置
            text = self.get(self.dragged_item)
            self.delete(self.dragged_item)
            self.insert(current_index, text)
            self.dragged_item = current_index
    
    def on_button_release(self, event):
        """鼠标释放事件"""
        self.dragged_item = None

class WinGUI(Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.__win()
        self.tk_list_box_listA1 = self.__tk_list_box_listA1(self)
        self.tk_label_mj549nb0 = self.__tk_label_mj549nb0(self)
        self.tk_label_mj54epp0 = self.__tk_label_mj54epp0(self)
        self.tk_list_box_listB1 = self.__tk_list_box_listB1(self)
        self.tk_button_saveAnNiu = self.__tk_button_saveAnNiu(self)
        
        # 存储歌曲信息
        self.songs_a1 = []  # listA1中的歌曲详细信息
        self.songs_b1 = []  # listB1中的歌曲详细信息
        self.current_cue_path = None  # 当前加载的CUE文件路径
        
        # 初始化拖放功能
        self.init_drag_drop()
    
    def __win(self):
        self.title("XSPF播放列表管理器")
        # 设置窗口大小、居中
        width = 600
        height = 500
        screenwidth = self.winfo_screenwidth()
        screenheight = self.winfo_screenheight()
        geometry = '%dx%d+%d+%d' % (width, height, (screenwidth - width) / 2, (screenheight - height) / 2)
        self.geometry(geometry)
        
        self.resizable(width=False, height=False)
        
    def scrollbar_autohide(self, vbar, hbar, widget):
        """自动隐藏滚动条"""
        def show():
            if vbar: vbar.lift(widget)
            if hbar: hbar.lift(widget)
        def hide():
            if vbar: vbar.lower(widget)
            if hbar: hbar.lower(widget)
        hide()
        widget.bind("&lt;Enter&gt;", lambda e: show())
        if vbar: vbar.bind("&lt;Enter&gt;", lambda e: show())
        if vbar: vbar.bind("&lt;Leave&gt;", lambda e: hide())
        if hbar: hbar.bind("&lt;Enter&gt;", lambda e: show())
        if hbar: hbar.bind("&lt;Leave&gt;", lambda e: hide())
        widget.bind("&lt;Leave&gt;", lambda e: hide())
    
    def v_scrollbar(self, vbar, widget, x, y, w, h, pw, ph):
        widget.configure(yscrollcommand=vbar.set)
        vbar.config(command=widget.yview)
        vbar.place(relx=(w + x) / pw, rely=y / ph, relheight=h / ph, anchor='ne')
    
    def h_scrollbar(self, hbar, widget, x, y, w, h, pw, ph):
        widget.configure(xscrollcommand=hbar.set)
        hbar.config(command=widget.xview)
        hbar.place(relx=x / pw, rely=(y + h) / ph, relwidth=w / pw, anchor='sw')
    
    def create_bar(self, master, widget, is_vbar, is_hbar, x, y, w, h, pw, ph):
        vbar, hbar = None, None
        if is_vbar:
            vbar = Scrollbar(master)
            self.v_scrollbar(vbar, widget, x, y, w, h, pw, ph)
        if is_hbar:
            hbar = Scrollbar(master, orient="horizontal")
            self.h_scrollbar(hbar, widget, x, y, w, h, pw, ph)
        self.scrollbar_autohide(vbar, hbar, widget)
    
    def __tk_list_box_listA1(self, parent):
        lb = DragDropListbox(parent)
        
        lb.insert(END, "歌单")
        
        lb.place(x=5, y=40, width=249, height=366)
        self.create_bar(parent, lb, True, True, 5, 40, 249, 366, 600, 500)
        
        # 绑定删除事件
        lb.bind('&lt;Delete&gt;', self.on_delete_item)
        
        return lb
    
    def __tk_label_mj549nb0(self, parent):
        label = Label(parent, text="XSPF播放列表歌曲目录", anchor="center")
        label.place(x=50, y=5, width=150, height=30)
        return label
    
    def __tk_label_mj54epp0(self, parent):
        label = Label(parent, text="拖入CUE文件", anchor="center")
        label.place(x=380, y=5, width=144, height=30)
        return label
    
    def __tk_list_box_listB1(self, parent):
        lb = Listbox(parent)
        
        lb.insert(END, "待加入歌单的歌曲")
        
        lb.place(x=353, y=40, width=215, height=367)
        self.create_bar(parent, lb, True, True, 353, 40, 215, 367, 600, 500)
        
        return lb
    
    def __tk_button_saveAnNiu(self, parent):
        btn = Button(parent, text="保存XSPF列表", takefocus=False, command=self.save_xspf)
        btn.place(x=72, y=414, width=120, height=30)
        return btn
    
    def init_drag_drop(self):
        """初始化拖放功能"""
        # 启用listB1的拖放源功能
        # 使用button=1（左键）启用拖放源
        self.tk_list_box_listB1.drag_source_register(1)
        # 绑定拖放初始化事件
        self.tk_list_box_listB1.dnd_bind('&lt;&lt;DragInitCmd&gt;&gt;', self.on_drag_init_b1)
        
        # 启用listA1的拖放目标功能，支持多种拖放类型
        self.tk_list_box_listA1.drop_target_register(DND_FILES, DND_TEXT)
        # 绑定拖放事件
        self.tk_list_box_listA1.dnd_bind('&lt;&lt;Drop&gt;&gt;', self.on_drop_a1)
        
        # 启用listB1的拖放目标功能
        self.tk_list_box_listB1.drop_target_register(DND_FILES)
        self.tk_list_box_listB1.dnd_bind('&lt;&lt;Drop&gt;&gt;', self.on_drop_b1)
        
        # 为listB1绑定鼠标按下和释放事件，实现自定义拖放
        self.tk_list_box_listB1.bind('&lt;ButtonPress-1&gt;', self.on_b1_press)
        self.tk_list_box_listB1.bind('&lt;B1-Motion&gt;', self.on_b1_motion)
        self.tk_list_box_listB1.bind('&lt;ButtonRelease-1&gt;', self.on_b1_release)
        
        # 初始化拖放变量
        self.drag_data = {
            'item': None,
            'widget': None,
            'start_x': 0,
            'start_y': 0
        }
    
    def on_b1_press(self, event):
        """listB1鼠标按下事件"""
        index = self.tk_list_box_listB1.nearest(event.y)
        if index &gt; 0:  # 跳过标题行
            self.drag_data['item'] = index
            self.drag_data['widget'] = self.tk_list_box_listB1
            self.drag_data['start_x'] = event.x_root
            self.drag_data['start_y'] = event.y_root
    
    def on_b1_motion(self, event):
        """listB1鼠标拖动事件"""
        if self.drag_data['item'] is not None:
            # 计算移动距离，如果移动超过一定距离，则开始拖放操作
            if (abs(event.x_root - self.drag_data['start_x']) &gt; 5 or 
                abs(event.y_root - self.drag_data['start_y']) &gt; 5):
                # 开始拖放操作
                index = self.drag_data['item']
                item_text = self.tk_list_box_listB1.get(index)
                
                # 将歌曲从listB1移动到listA1
                if item_text and item_text != "待加入歌单的歌曲" and not item_text.startswith("CUE文件:"):
                    # 查找对应的歌曲信息
                    song_info = None
                    for i, song in enumerate(self.songs_b1):
                        if song.get('title') == item_text:
                            song_info = song
                            break
                    
                    if song_info:
                        # 添加到listA1
                        self.tk_list_box_listA1.insert(END, item_text)
                        # 保存歌曲信息
                        self.songs_a1.append(song_info.copy())
                        # 从listB1中删除
                        self.tk_list_box_listB1.delete(index)
                        # 从songs_b1中删除
                        if song_info in self.songs_b1:
                            self.songs_b1.remove(song_info)
                        
                        # 重置拖放数据
                        self.drag_data['item'] = None
                        self.drag_data['widget'] = None
                        return
    
    def on_b1_release(self, event):
        """listB1鼠标释放事件"""
        self.drag_data['item'] = None
        self.drag_data['widget'] = None
    
    def on_drag_init_b1(self, event):
        """初始化从listB1拖动"""
        index = self.tk_list_box_listB1.curselection()
        if index:
            index = index[0]
            if index &gt; 0:  # 跳过标题行
                item_text = self.tk_list_box_listB1.get(index)
                return (DND_TEXT,), (item_text,), ("")
    
    def on_drop_a1(self, event):
        """拖放到listA1事件"""
        # 获取拖放数据
        data = event.data
        
        # 检查是否是从listB1拖入的文本（判断event.widget是否是listA1）
        if isinstance(data, tuple):
            # 处理元组类型的拖放数据（从listB1拖入）
            if len(data) &gt; 0:
                item_text = data[0]
                # 从listB1拖入的歌曲
                song_info = None
                index_to_remove = None
                
                # 查找对应的歌曲信息
                for i, song in enumerate(self.songs_b1):
                    if song.get('title') == item_text:
                        song_info = song
                        index_to_remove = i
                        break
                
                if song_info:
                    # 添加到listA1
                    self.tk_list_box_listA1.insert(END, item_text)
                    # 保存歌曲信息
                    self.songs_a1.append(song_info.copy())
                    
                    # 从listB1中删除
                    if index_to_remove is not None:
                        # 注意：索引需要加1，因为listB1的第一行是标题
                        self.tk_list_box_listB1.delete(index_to_remove + 1)
                        # 从songs_b1中删除
                        self.songs_b1.pop(index_to_remove)
        elif isinstance(data, str):
            # 检查是否是文件拖放（包含文件路径格式）
            if data.startswith('{') or '\\' in data or '/' in data:
                # 处理从资源管理器拖入的文件
                files = self.tk.splitlist(data)
                for file_path in files:
                    # 处理文件路径（去除花括号）
                    file_path = file_path.strip('{}')
                    if os.path.isfile(file_path):
                        # 添加到listA1
                        file_name = os.path.basename(file_path)
                        self.tk_list_box_listA1.insert(END, file_name)
                        # 保存歌曲信息
                        self.songs_a1.append({
                            'title': file_name,
                            'path': file_path,
                            'group_title': os.path.dirname(file_path)
                        })
            else:
                # 处理从listB1拖入的文本
                song_info = None
                index_to_remove = None
                
                for i, song in enumerate(self.songs_b1):
                    if song.get('title') == data:
                        song_info = song
                        index_to_remove = i
                        break
                
                if song_info:
                    # 添加到listA1
                    self.tk_list_box_listA1.insert(END, data)
                    # 保存歌曲信息
                    self.songs_a1.append(song_info.copy())
                    
                    # 从listB1中删除
                    if index_to_remove is not None:
                        # 注意：索引需要加1，因为listB1的第一行是标题
                        self.tk_list_box_listB1.delete(index_to_remove + 1)
                        self.songs_b1.pop(index_to_remove)
    
    def on_drop_b1(self, event):
        """拖放到listB1事件"""
        # 获取拖入的文件路径
        files = self.tk.splitlist(event.data)
        for file_path in files:
            # 处理文件路径（去除花括号）
            file_path = file_path.strip('{}')
            if os.path.isfile(file_path) and file_path.lower().endswith('.cue'):
                # 清空之前的内容
                self.tk_list_box_listB1.delete(0, END)
                self.songs_b1.clear()
                
                # 解析CUE文件
                try:
                    # 读取CUE文件内容，尝试多种编码
                    cue_content = None
                    encodings = ['utf-8', 'gbk', 'gb2312', 'cp936']
                    for encoding in encodings:
                        try:
                            with open(file_path, 'r', encoding=encoding) as f:
                                cue_content = f.read()
                            break
                        except UnicodeDecodeError:
                            continue
                    
                    if cue_content is None:
                        raise Exception("无法解析CUE文件编码")
                    
                    # 使用自定义解析CUE文件（更可靠）
                    self.parse_cue_file_custom(file_path, cue_content)
                    
                    # 保存当前CUE文件路径
                    self.current_cue_path = file_path
                    
                except Exception as e:
                    messagebox.showerror("错误", f"解析CUE文件失败: {e}")
    
    def parse_cue_file_custom(self, cue_path, cue_content):
        """自定义解析CUE文件（更可靠的方法）"""
        # 清空之前的内容
        self.tk_list_box_listB1.delete(0, END)
        self.songs_b1.clear()
        
        # 解析CUE文件
        lines = cue_content.split('\n')
        
        # 初始化变量
        album_title = ""
        album_performer = ""
        audio_file = ""
        cue_dir = os.path.dirname(cue_path)
        
        tracks = []
        current_track = None
        
        for line in lines:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            
            # 解析音轨
            if line.upper().startswith('TRACK'):
                # 保存上一个音轨
                if current_track:
                    tracks.append(current_track)
                
                match = re.search(r'TRACK\s+(\d+)', line, re.IGNORECASE)
                if match:
                    track_num = int(match.group(1))
                    current_track = {
                        'track_num': track_num,
                        'title': f"未知歌曲 {track_num}",
                        'performer': album_performer,
                        'start_time': 0
                    }
            
            # 解析音频文件
            elif line.upper().startswith('FILE'):
                match = re.search(r'"(.*?)"', line)
                if match:
                    audio_file_name = match.group(1)
                    audio_file = os.path.join(cue_dir, audio_file_name)
                    # 检查音频文件是否存在
                    if not os.path.exists(audio_file):
                        # 尝试在相同目录下查找文件
                        base_name = os.path.basename(audio_file_name)
                        test_path = os.path.join(cue_dir, base_name)
                        if os.path.exists(test_path):
                            audio_file = test_path
            
            # 解析音轨标题
            elif line.upper().startswith('TITLE') and current_track:
                match = re.search(r'TITLE\s+"(.*?)"', line, re.IGNORECASE)
                if match:
                    current_track['title'] = match.group(1)
            
            # 解析音轨表演者
            elif line.upper().startswith('PERFORMER') and current_track:
                match = re.search(r'PERFORMER\s+"(.*?)"', line, re.IGNORECASE)
                if match:
                    current_track['performer'] = match.group(1)
            
            # 解析索引时间
            elif line.upper().startswith('INDEX 01') and current_track:
                match = re.search(r'INDEX\s+01\s+(\d+:\d+:\d+)', line, re.IGNORECASE)
                if match:
                    time_str = match.group(1)
                    current_track['start_time'] = XSPFGenerator.cue_time_to_seconds(time_str)
            
            # 解析专辑标题（只有在没有current_track时才解析）
            elif line.upper().startswith('TITLE') and not current_track:
                match = re.search(r'TITLE\s+"(.*?)"', line, re.IGNORECASE)
                if match:
                    album_title = match.group(1)
            
            # 解析专辑表演者（只有在没有current_track时才解析）
            elif line.upper().startswith('PERFORMER') and not current_track:
                match = re.search(r'PERFORMER\s+"(.*?)"', line, re.IGNORECASE)
                if match:
                    album_performer = match.group(1)
        
        # 添加最后一个音轨
        if current_track:
            tracks.append(current_track)
        
        # 添加到listB1
        self.tk_list_box_listB1.insert(END, f"CUE文件: {os.path.basename(cue_path)}")
        
        # 添加每首歌曲到listB1
        for i, track in enumerate(tracks):
            title = track['title']
            
            # 添加到listB1
            self.tk_list_box_listB1.insert(END, title)
            
            # 计算结束时间
            start_time = track['start_time']
            end_time = 0
            if i &lt; len(tracks) - 1:
                end_time = tracks[i+1]['start_time']
            
            # 确保音频文件路径不为空
            audio_file_path = audio_file if audio_file else ""
            
            # 保存歌曲信息
            song_info = {
                'title': title,
                'performer': track['performer'],
                'album': album_title,
                'track_num': f"{track['track_num']:02d}",
                'path': audio_file_path  # 必须项：音频文件路径
            }
            
            # 对于CUE歌曲，必须添加cue_info
            if audio_file_path:
                song_info['cue_info'] = {
                    'fileURI': f"{cue_path}:{i}",
                    'clipStart': start_time,
                    'clipFinish': end_time
                }
            else:
                # 如果没有音频文件路径，仍然添加cue_info，但设置默认值
                song_info['cue_info'] = {
                    'fileURI': f"{cue_path}:{i}",
                    'clipStart': start_time,
                    'clipFinish': end_time
                }
            
            self.songs_b1.append(song_info)
    
    def on_delete_item(self, event):
        """删除选中项事件"""
        selected = self.tk_list_box_listA1.curselection()
        if selected:
            index = selected[0]
            if index &gt; 0:  # 不删除标题行
                self.tk_list_box_listA1.delete(index)
                # 删除对应的歌曲信息
                if 0 &lt;= index - 1 &lt; len(self.songs_a1):
                    del self.songs_a1[index - 1]
    
    def save_xspf(self):
        """保存XSPF列表"""
        # 获取要保存的歌曲列表
        songs_to_save = []
        for i in range(1, self.tk_list_box_listA1.size()):
            # listA1中的第i项对应songs_a1中的第i-1项
            index = i - 1
            if index &lt; len(self.songs_a1):
                song_info = self.songs_a1[index]
                songs_to_save.append(song_info)
            else:
                song_name = self.tk_list_box_listA1.get(i)
                # 对于没有详细信息的歌曲，只添加标题
                songs_to_save.append({'title': song_name})
        
        if not songs_to_save:
            messagebox.showwarning("警告", "没有歌曲可以保存")
            return
        
        # 选择保存路径
        file_path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            defaultextension=".xspf",
            filetypes=[("XSPF播放列表", "*.xspf"), ("所有文件", "*.*")],
            title="保存XSPF播放列表"
        )
        
        if file_path:
            # 生成XSPF文件
            XSPFGenerator.generate_xspf(songs_to_save, file_path)

class Win(WinGUI):
    def __init__(self, controller):
        self.ctl = controller
        super().__init__()
        self.__event_bind()
        self.__style_config()
        self.ctl.init(self)
    
    def __event_bind(self):
        pass
    
    def __style_config(self):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    win = WinGUI()
    win.mainloop()</pre></div></td></tr></tbody></table>
